cases.name: b1c.s4.excitation_direct_vs_block.vacuum
cases.notes: the direct route never mentions the observer and the block route mentions nothing else; a wrong scale, sign, transposition or dual index pair in the decomposition would separate them
cases.reference: H^{ab} = Z^{abcd}F_{cd} computed directly equals H^{ab} rebuilt from (D,H) obtained by applying eps, mu^-1, zeta and zeta_adjoint to (E,B)

cases.name: b1c.s4.field_spatiality
cases.notes: structural, not incidental: each field is a contraction of an antisymmetric two-form with V on one slot and V_a on the other
cases.reference: V_a E^a = V_a B^a = V_a D^a = V_a H^a = 0

cases.name: b1c.s4.field_strength_from_E_and_B
cases.reference: F_{ab} = V_a E_b - V_b E_a + eps_{abcd}V^c B^d recovers the original F, i.e. (A1) is an invertible split

cases.name: b1c.s4.excitation_from_D_and_H
cases.reference: the same split applied to the excitation recovers H^{ab} from (D, magnetic excitation)

cases.name: b1c.s4.excitation_antisymmetry
cases.reference: H^{ab} = -H^{ba}

cases.name: b1c.s4.linearity
cases.reference: H[alpha F1 + beta F2] = alpha H[F1] + beta H[F2] through the block path

cases.name: b1c.s4.vacuum_excitation_is_raised_F
cases.notes: this is what names D and H; every constitutive sign downstream is read against it
cases.reference: in vacuum H^{ab} = F^{ab}, hence D = E and the magnetic excitation equals B

cases.expected_description: min over media of max|H - F^{ab}| above 1e-2
cases.name: b1c.s4.media_are_not_vacuum
cases.reference: every non-vacuum medium responds measurably differently from vacuum, so the reconstruction cases are not trivially satisfied

cases.name: b1c.s5.b17_zeta_magnitude
cases.notes: absolute agreement, not proportionality: the normalisation was pinned at step 5 and is asserted here as a value
cases.reference: zeta^{ac} = 2 V_a V_c (Z*)^{abcd} equals the closed form (B17) zeta_W^{ac} = (eps - mu^-1)(V.W) eps^{acef} W_e V_f

cases.name: b1c.s5.b17_zeta_sign
cases.notes: one direction is asserted. The provisional guess was -2 W_zeta and it was wrong
cases.reference: the extracted zeta matches (B17) with the POSITIVE sign, and is far from the negated reference

cases.name: b1c.s5.b17_is_antisymmetric
cases.notes: needed before zeta_adjoint can be compared against the transpose of (B17), otherwise that comparison would be circular
cases.reference: (B17) gives an antisymmetric zeta, so its transpose is its negative

cases.name: b1c.s5.zeta_adjoint_matches_analytic
cases.notes: this is what pins the zeta_adjoint normalisation. It was carried at the same +2 as zeta by symmetry with (A6b); that assumption is now measured against a medium with a known nonzero response
cases.reference: zeta_adjoint^{ac} = 2 V_a V_c (*Z)^{abcd} equals the transpose of the (B17) closed form, i.e. -(B17)

cases.name: b1c.s5.reciprocity_moving_medium
cases.notes: checked, not assumed: the two blocks are extracted from DIFFERENT duals (*Z and Z*) and stored separately
cases.reference: zeta_adjoint = zeta^T for the moving isotropic medium, as required by the pair symmetry Z^{abcd} = Z^{cdab} of equation (13)

cases.name: b1c.s5.handedness_direction
cases.notes: ONE direction is asserted. This is not a comparison of both signs with the better one accepted: a +y result fails
cases.reference: for V = (1,0,0,0), a medium with eps > mu^-1 boosted along +x, and B = +B0 z-hat with E = 0, the induced displacement points along -y

cases.name: b1c.s5.handedness_magnitude
cases.reference: D_y = -(eps - mu^-1) gamma^2 beta B0, the exact (B17) value

cases.name: b1c.s5.handedness_matches_minkowski_relations
cases.notes: an independent physical reference OUTSIDE Schuster & Visser. It is what rules out the possibility that the whole convention chain is self-consistently mirrored
cases.reference: at beta = 1e-3 the computed D_y agrees with D = eps E + (eps - mu^-1)(v x B), the first-order form of Minkowski's moving-medium relations D + v x H = eps(E + v x B)

cases.name: b1c.a11.roundtrip.vacuum
cases.notes: (A11) is written out term by term from the source; no tensor component is fitted
cases.reference: Z -> (eps, mu^-1, zeta, zeta_adjoint) -> Zhat via (A11) returns the original Z

cases.name: b1c.a11.roundtrip.isotropic_rest
cases.notes: (A11) is written out term by term from the source; no tensor component is fitted
cases.reference: Z -> (eps, mu^-1, zeta, zeta_adjoint) -> Zhat via (A11) returns the original Z

cases.notes: (A11) is written out term by term from the source; no tensor component is fitted
cases.reference: Z -> (eps, mu^-1, zeta, zeta_adjoint) -> Zhat via (A11) returns the original Z

cases.name: b1c.a11.roundtrip.moving_isotropic
cases.notes: (A11) is written out term by term from the source; no tensor component is fitted
cases.reference: Z -> (eps, mu^-1, zeta, zeta_adjoint) -> Zhat via (A11) returns the original Z

cases.name: b1c.a11.roundtrip.warp_analogue
cases.notes: (A11) is written out term by term from the source; no tensor component is fitted
cases.reference: Z -> (eps, mu^-1, zeta, zeta_adjoint) -> Zhat via (A11) returns the original Z

cases.name: b1c.a11.random_reciprocal_roundtrip
cases.notes: generic eps, mu^-1 and zeta -- in particular a zeta that is neither symmetric nor antisymmetric, which no special medium provides
cases.reference: (A11) returns the original Z for random constitutive tensors carrying only the symmetries (12) and (13)

cases.name: b1c.a11.random_reciprocal_excitation
cases.reference: direct and block excitation agree for random reciprocal media

cases.name: b1c.a11.random_reciprocity_holds
cases.reference: zeta_adjoint = zeta^T for every random reciprocal Z

cases.expected_description: correct slot exact, wrong slot fails by more than 1e-1
cases.name: b1c.a11.magnetoelectric_slot
cases.notes: DETERMINED, and determined by a test no sign convention could pass. For a symmetric zeta the transpose is the identity and for the moving-medium zeta it is a sign flip, so either alone would license the wrong reading; a generic zeta separates them
cases.reference: the magnetoelectric slot of (A11) is filled by zeta_adjoint and not by zeta: substituting zeta destroys the reconstruction

cases.expected_description: both observers admissible and max block difference above 1e-3
cases.name: b1c.observer_change.blocks_differ
cases.notes: if the blocks did not differ, the reconstruction agreement below would say nothing about observer independence
cases.reference: two admissible laboratory observers of the SAME Z see genuinely different eps, mu^-1 and zeta

cases.name: b1c.observer_change.reconstruction
cases.parameters: V = lab rest, U = boosted beta_y = 0.5, warp-analogue Z
cases.reference: Zhat[V] = Z, Zhat[U] = Z and Zhat[V] = Zhat[U]: the blocks are observer dependent, the tensor they rebuild is not

cases.name: b1c.coordinate_change.transformation_is_nontrivial
cases.notes: a general tensor test. g_lab' is NOT a claim about a curved laboratory, and g_eff plays no part in it
cases.reference: the coordinate map is invertible and takes g_lab away from Minkowski, so the covariance test is not performed in disguise on eta itself

cases.name: b1c.coordinate_change.direct_excitation
cases.reference: H'^{ab} = Z'^{abcd}F'_{cd} equals L^a_c L^b_d H^{cd}

cases.name: b1c.coordinate_change.block_excitation
cases.notes: this is the case that would break if the Levi-Civita tensor were built from a hard-coded Minkowski symbol instead of g_lab
cases.reference: the block path, rebuilt entirely in the primed coordinates from the primed observer and the primed g_lab, gives the same H'^{ab}

cases.name: b1c.coordinate_change.a11_reconstruction
cases.reference: (A11) in the primed coordinates returns Z'

cases.name: b1c.types.observer_apis_are_distinct
cases.notes: the wrappers are not decoration: substituting one for the other changes the numbers, and the constitutive blocks would then belong to no observer at all. The two constructors return different C++ types so the substitution cannot compile
cases.reference: the same raw four-velocity normalised as a laboratory observer and as an effective-geometry diagnostic gives genuinely different vectors, each unit-timelike in its OWN metric

title: B1C-S456: full electromagnetic field reconstruction H^{ab} = Z^{abcd}F_{cd}, the magnetoelectric remainder (zeta_adjoint, reciprocity, handedness), and reconstruction of Z from the observer blocks via Schuster & Visser (A11)
